findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1 second, so existing callers that rely on the previous lower bound of 0 now get waits clamped up to 1 second.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller uses wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, max=10) or any config whose computed wait is below 1s without passing min. Before this change the wait could be about 0.1s; now max(max(0, 1), ...) forces at least 1s. Impact: retry timing silently changes for existing users, which can slow retries or break tests that expect short waits.
